subject: english
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

All the members of my family are planning to visit Jammu and Kashmir this Novembur.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. November.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Novembur" is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"November"**. (नवंबर)

 
 
• **Example: **We have a family tradition of celebrating Thanksgiving in November.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Novembur**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Planning** (योजना): The process of making plans for something.

 
 
• **Example:** We are planning a trip to the mountains next summer.
 
 
 
• **Visit** (दौरा): To go and see a place or person for a period of time.
 
 
• **Example: **We plan to visit the museum this weekend.
 
 
 
• **Members** (सदस्य): Individuals belonging to a group or organization.
 
 
• **Example:** All the members of the club attended the annual meeting.
